fields.title: Assess engineering changes between exact configurations
fields.statement: Engineers can compare two exact captured engineering configurations, explain changes and supported/uncertain scope, and complete justified assessment/verification follow-through with historical evidence preserved.
fields.acceptance: AC-1: Controlled capture retains an explicit bounded set of exact native member/relationship revisions, external observation selections, schema/context and declared scope; omissions and legacy captures never imply undeclared topology/content completeness. Stable caller identity and captured original intent recover an identical committed capture after lost response/restart without duplicate creation or silent rebasing; conflicting intent/guards/provenance reject. AC-2: A deterministic read-only comparison binds two immutable configuration identities and all governing policy/state digests. Later live native/evidence changes do not alter that pair comparison; switching either side is explicit. Incompatible subject/project/model/schema/scope and unavailable historical information produce explained comparability/uncertainty or refusal rather than inferred equivalence. AC-3: Native comparison explains added/removed membership, type/key/resource/field differences and version-only changes with exact original/current-selected versions, schemas and provenance. Missing versus null, ordered arrays and nested JSON remain meaningful. Removed-from-configuration is distinct from deleted-from-project, and mutable current liveness is not silently substituted for the selected state. AC-4: Selected relationship topology comparison preserves exact endpoints, type, metadata and contextual-reference role/selector/state changes, including relinking, removed relationships and historical endpoints. Undeclared legacy topology is explicitly unknown, not an empty complete graph; no reachability implies engineering causation or membership. AC-5: Content comparison uses explicitly captured resource/observation identities, availability and hashes/commits; annotation changes and observed-byte changes remain separate. Same hash is not identity merging or byte retention, and document change cannot establish passage change without sufficient selected evidence. Reads perform no observer IO and never replace pinned selections with the latest observation. AC-6: Configuration-bound dependency/applicability analysis explains changed inputs, potentially affected and unaffected declared scope, exact inclusion/exclusion basis and remaining uncertainty. Captured input field/path/direct-link/content semantics are reused; incomplete scope, absent evidence and unknown availability cannot establish no impact. Bounded populations and summaries state completeness and refuse overflow explicitly. AC-7: Controlled pair-bound assessments preserve the original pair/policy and every discovered obligation, reasoned disposition, action and immutable conclusion. No-action, investigation, required revision and re-verification remain distinct. Pair/policy changes require explicit reassessment while retaining prior judgments; closure requires complete accounting under the pinned policy and never implies release approval. AC-8: Verification follow-through retains exact criterion/method/candidate/support states and explains whether selected recorded outcomes apply to the target configuration, independently of unrelated live-head changes. Existing current-head verification keeps its meaning. Failed/not_run results stay non-passing; generic reviews/status strings cannot override changed governing criteria, incomplete accounting or unknown support. Work executed after configuration capture can support that candidate only through validated exact input correspondence and explicit provenance, never by silently adding membership. AC-9: Core, typed HTTP/client and CLI/agent interfaces share the same domain operations, captured queries and original-intent recovery. Atomic guards reject stale/concurrent/invalid proposals without partial state/history/evidence/outcomes; failed reads pause writes and uncertain writes are inspected without automatic replay. Existing API/storage/receipt/configuration/baseline/assessment/verification contracts retain their semantics and historical readability. AC-10: The shared workspace captures/selects the pair, explains native/content/topology differences and comparable/unknown scope, investigates consequences, records dispositions, opens appropriate existing assessment/verification follow-through and shows outstanding/resolved work. Drafts survive navigation, stale inputs require explicit adoption, lost responses use shared recovery and supported responsive views preserve exact context. A fresh independent agent completes an unfamiliar task and material findings are addressed; human validation remains separate. AC-11: A justified real Tracer software change retains exact before/after configurations and original conclusions, identifies actual changed and unaffected scope, completes necessary assessment/verification and explains final remaining work without manufactured engineering claims. A materially different configured domain demonstrates the same semantics. Exact candidate/procedure/results cover additions/removals, reference/content changes, unavailable/deleted inputs, partial/incompatible scope, drift, supersession/reassessment and workload/payload boundaries. AC-12: Existing identities, native/evidence history, command outcomes and both prior application capabilities are preserved; necessary migrations are rehearsed and deterministic export/online SQLite backup/restored recovery verified. Appropriate regression, browser, architecture and quality gates pass unchanged. Owning architecture/usage docs, checkpoint and register retain exact evidence, unchanged criteria, delivery/verification/human-validation distinctions and remaining limits. Full goal acceptance is audited before completion.
fields.remaining: All AC-1–12 implementation and complete goal verification remain pending. Existing contract audit identifies reusable mechanisms and concrete gaps only; representative-human/backend/regulatory/arbitrary-scale claims remain separate.

Audit all twelve criteria and the complete goal before promotion.
